note: M27 (D-060): the one source of truth for the Vanilla / HD+ / Custom presets. tools/r3hd_settings.py resolves it; tools/play.ps1 parameter defaults must equal the vanilla column (m27_settings_regression.py). Categories: mandatory = native compatibility / safety, the same in every preset and not a preference (a different value is a diagnostic launch only); platform = native PC behaviour with a console-faithful default; hd_correction = reversible correction of an inherited Xbox 360 HD defect; enhancement = optional quality of life; experimental = insufficiently verified, Custom only and only with allow_experimental. M30 (D-067): scope 'preset' (the default) = decided by the preset, changed only in Custom; scope 'preference' = a per-installation choice, the same default in every preset, adjustable under any preset and kept when the preset changes. group / label / help / value_labels are what the installer and the Settings launcher show (tools/r3hd_installer.py launcher-model); the launcher holds no setting of its own. M31 (D-068): install_default = the value a brand-new installation stores (a preference only; upgrades and repairs keep their settings.json); ui 'hidden' = resolved and kept but not shown in the launcher or configure; requires = the setting applies only while another setting has that value (the launcher disables it otherwise). G6-P49 (D-303): ui 'left_column' = a two-value corrections preference drawn as a check box with its help at the end of the Settings page's left column, under the button prompts (at most one).

presets.vanilla: Xbox 360 HD presentation and gameplay with the essential native PC compatibility and safety behaviour.
presets.hdplus: Vanilla plus the curated, evidence-supported corrections whose validation gate has passed, and those marked provisional that the person chose to include before their in-game look (M43, D-080).
presets.custom: A base preset (vanilla or hdplus) plus individually chosen overrides of adjustable settings.

vanilla.name: Vanilla
vanilla.text: The Xbox 360 release, with the fixes it needs on PC.

hdplus.name: HD+ (Recommended)
hdplus.text: Fixes visual issues inherited from the Xbox 360 HD release.

custom.name: Custom
custom.text: Pick each correction yourself, including unchecked ones.

revisit.label: Revisit-mode progression fix
revisit.why: progression safety: without it a finished or re-chosen revisit can strand a save in the end-of-game hub

pacing.label: Frame pacing (exact 60 Hz simulation step)
pacing.why: the title's 16 ms simulation step of an exact 60 Hz vblank; pinned polling is for comparison only

display.label: Display mode
display.why: the runtime's own borderless fullscreen at the desktop mode (M15); a window otherwise. A new installation starts in fullscreen (M31, D-068); an existing installation keeps its choice

window_size.label: Window size
window_size.help: In screen pixels, for Window mode; reduced to fit your screen. The rendering resolution is set separately.
window_size.why: the SDL window's client size in physical pixels; the guest video mode stays 1280x720 and the rendering resolution is a separate setting

render_scale.label: Rendering resolution
render_scale.help: Auto selects 720p, 1440p, or 2160p to cover the 16:9 game picture on your screen or window, not counting black bars. On a 1080p display, Auto renders at 1440p; you can select 1920x1080 (1.5x) manually on Windows (D3D12), or 720p if performance is poor.
render_scale.why: the same 1280x720 frame drawn at a larger internal size; 1 is the original resolution, 1.5 is native 1920x1080 on Windows D3D12

display_vsync.label: V-Sync
display_vsync.help: Prevents screen tearing; can add slight input delay. Graphics driver settings may override it. Windows only.
display_vsync.why: Windows only: host presentation of the D3D12 presenter (Present sync interval 1 with a bounded frame queue); the 60 Hz guest vblank and simulation step (D-046) are unchanged; never the SDK's guest-vblank `vsync` cvar (E-265); the Linux Vulkan presenter does not read it

combo_close.label: Combo Meter Animation
combo_close.help: Adds a smooth exit animation to the Combo Meter during the final second of a combo.
combo_close.validation: E-312: recreated HUD and short nonzero scoring comparison; real 2s/6s windows, refresh and human appearance accepted
combo_close.why: reuse the title's upward HUD exit during the final second of the actual combo countdown

layer_coords.label: Separate texture coordinates for two-layer effects
layer_coords.help: Makes haze and cloud layers move separately in the Bog of Murk and Land of the Livid Dead.
layer_coords.validation: passed (D-054): mechanism VERIFIED from the title's own shaders and traces; hidden before / after runs judged by m23_regression.py --pair; visually indistinct to the user, which D-054 counts for neither side
layer_coords.why: two-layer translucent sheets sample both layers on the first coordinate set in the HD release

red_correction.label: Correct HD Lighting Colors
red_correction.help: Removes the unnatural pink tint introduced by the HD release in Hoodlum Headquarters and the Tower of the Leptys.
red_correction.validation: passed (D-151): identity of the bypassed pass VERIFIED from the microcode and hidden same-frame A/B frames (E-346); gate G-HDP-L1 human visual pass in Hoodlum Headquarters and the Tower of the Leptys, 2026-10-31 (E-348)
red_correction.why: the HD release's final red-correction pass turns deep red lava pink in five levels (E-345)

texture_orient.label: Correct Texture Orientation
texture_orient.help: Fixes upside-down Robo-Pirate statue textures in Hoodlum Headquarters and Ugly textures in the Bog of Murk.
texture_orient.validation: Robo-Pirate statues human accepted (D-163); Ugly mechanism, mips and hidden delivery verified (E-433), human close-view acceptance pending; provisional flag retained
texture_orient.why: four Robo-Pirate statue pages and swamp_50's Ugly body page stored the other way up from their meshes; E-433 verifies the Ugly mechanism, human acceptance pending

sky_clear.label: Correct Sky Colors
sky_clear.help: Restores the sky color in Clearleaf Forest and the Bog of Murk.
sky_clear.validation: passed (D-156): the black scene clear and the level's stored background colour VERIFIED statically and in hidden runs (E-349, E-350); applied in wood_11 and swamp_60 only (E-351); human visual pass against 2003 PC screenshots in Clearleaf Forest and the Bog of Murk, 2026-10-31 (E-352)
sky_clear.why: the HD release clears every scene to black, so the transparent top of the sky dome (Clearleaf Forest) and the gaps between the clouds (Bog of Murk) show black instead of the level's background colour

lit_uv_scroll.label: Correct Charge Trail Colors
lit_uv_scroll.help: Restores the red-to-orange glow of the trail behind Rayman's charged punch.
lit_uv_scroll.validation: passed (D-159): the trail's vertex shader 1t_d_lighting drops the UV offset c10 the title writes with the charge (E-353); one-instruction copy, c10 delivery and the shader's other users (offset zero) VERIFIED in hidden runs (E-354); human visual pass against the 2003 PC footage, 2026-10-31 (E-355)
lit_uv_scroll.why: the HD release's shader for the fist-charge trail ignores the scroll of its fire gradient, so the trail stays a faint grey wisp instead of turning red, then orange, as the charge grows

power_swirl.label: Restore Power-Up Spiral
power_swirl.help: Restores the colored spiral around Rayman when a power-up is acquired or expires.
power_swirl.validation: Windows human visual PASS: enabled blue LockJaw swirl matches original-PC intent (E-446); automated Shock Rocket pickup/expiry checked (E-445). Other colors/transitions/scenes and full GPU-state/replay qualification remain limited.
power_swirl.why: The original PC power-transition spiral retains its geometry and materials in HD, but its quad submission is empty.

beam_color.label: Restore Power-Up Canister Colors
beam_color.help: Restores the purple beam and rings of power-up cans from the original PC release instead of orange.
beam_color.validation: Windows human visual PASS: restored purple canister beam and upper/lower rings (E-448). Beam pages verified per pixel and hash-gated in all 39 bundles; ring page ago_blueripple (HD redraw) gets the same rotation; hidden off/on runs verify screen ownership (E-447). Other scenes and ring-page users, Linux runtime and full replay qualification remain limited.
beam_color.why: The HD release's two power-up beam pages are the original purple PC pages with their color channels rotated, so the beams turn orange; the HD redraw of the purple PC ring page uses the same orange palette.

lockon_far_color.label: Restore Out-of-Range Lock-On Color
lockon_far_color.help: Shows the lock-on indicator for a target beyond your fist's reach in blue, as in the original PC release, instead of orange.
lockon_far_color.validation: Windows human visual PASS: restored blue out-of-range indicator (E-453). Page ago_targetfar identified by draw trace in knaar_69 (E-451/E-452); hash-gated endpoint recolor keeps the HD eight-dash art; hidden off/on run verifies screen ownership. Other levels, Linux runtime and full replay qualification remain limited.
lockon_far_color.why: The HD release redrew the original blue PC out-of-range indicator as an orange eight-dash ring; the normal lock-on ring and arrows are separate pages and stay as they are.

crown_cutout.label: Correct Grand Minimus's Crown
crown_cutout.help: Renders the Teensie King crown as a solid cutout so rear faces no longer show through the front.
crown_cutout.validation: G6-P127 Windows human visual PASS on menu_00 (D-363); all 10 verified teensy_cour.dds bundles (menu_00 + 9 resource-equivalent levels, visual acceptance pending on the other 9) hash-gated fail-closed before M33 mods.
crown_cutout.why: In the Xbox 360 HD release, the double-sided Teensie King crown material (charact\teensy_cour.dds) uses alpha-blended blend_byte 0x03 with depth writes disabled instead of cutout 0x08, letting rear crown faces overwrite the front gold band.

gameplay_subtitles.label: Gameplay subtitles
gameplay_subtitles.help: Also outside cutscenes. The game's Subtitles option still applies.
gameplay_subtitles.validation: M44 (D-081): the title's rule VERIFIED from its code and hidden traces; D-090: a per-installation preference (Settings > Corrections), on for a fresh HD+ installation
gameplay_subtitles.why: the Xbox 360 HD release shows gameplay voice subtitles only in cinematic mode or for a fixed list of lines (title design, not a port defect)

hud_toggle.label: Score HUD toggle (F5)
hud_toggle.help: F5 hides or shows the score and Combo Meter. Other HUD stays.
hud_toggle.validation: E-359 / E-360: the private trailer gate hid and restored the score panel and Combo row on a genuine Moor_00 save; E-530: the same gate and F5 rules in the normal build
hud_toggle.why: issue #6: a clean picture for screenshots and recordings; the title has no such option. Only the score / Combo draw has a verified visual-only gate

controller_prompts.label: Controller button prompts
controller_prompts.help: Choose which controller button icons appear in-game. Auto identifies the primary or sole controller at launch; unknown or ambiguous controllers use Xbox. Restart after changing controllers.
controller_prompts.why: launch-time Auto or manual artwork override, independent of profiles and gameplay bindings

mouse_camera.label: Mouse Camera
mouse_camera.help: Turns the camera with the mouse during gameplay. The pointer stays in the game window only while you play; menus, pause and Alt+Tab release it.
mouse_camera.why: an Xbox 360 pad has no mouse; an optional native PC camera control that is off by default, so an existing installation behaves as before

mouse_sensitivity.label: Mouse Sensitivity
mouse_sensitivity.help: How fast the mouse turns the camera. 50% is the default.

mouse_buttons.label: Mouse Buttons
mouse_buttons.help: In gameplay, uses the mouse buttons assigned on the Controls page (by default left = Attack, right = Lock On).
mouse_buttons.why: the mouse buttons assigned on the Controls page act in gameplay only while this is on; off keeps every existing installation as it was

game_language.label: Game language
game_language.help: Applies next launch: text, subtitles and voices. Turkish/PT-BR mods need English; disable them for the other languages.
game_language.validation: Issue #2: native menus, subtitles and selected movie audio verified for all five; full campaign audio not audited
game_language.why: Selects the target's native emulated-console language; independent of the Settings interface and mods

ui_language.label: Settings language
ui_language.help: Language of Settings, independent of the game and its mods.
ui_language.why: Settings UI language is independent of the game; setup initializes it only for a fresh installation

cursor.label: Mouse cursor
cursor.help: Hidden while the game window is in front; moving the mouse shows it.
cursor.why: the console has no pointer; auto hides it over the focused window

save_clock.label: Save times
save_clock.help: The time shown next to saves in the game's menus.
save_clock.why: a console shows save times in its own time zone

discord_presence.label: Discord Rich Presence
discord_presence.help: Share the game identity and elapsed session time with Discord.
discord_presence.why: Share only the game identity and elapsed session time with a running Discord client

dualsense_light.label: DualSense light bar
dualsense_light.help: The light bar takes the colour of the current world. DualSense only; other controllers are never changed.
dualsense_light.why: an Xbox 360 pad has no light bar; a PC DualSense player may want one that follows the game (D-108: on for a new installation or an update from 1.0.0, an absent choice of a 1.0.1 home stays off)

dualsense_trigger.label: DualSense R2 resistance
dualsense_trigger.help: A light R2 resistance in gameplay, felt as soon as you press it. DualSense only; it never changes what R2 does.
dualsense_trigger.why: an Xbox 360 pad has no adaptive trigger; an optional, gentle effect for DualSense players (D-108: on for a new installation or an update from 1.0.0, an absent choice of a 1.0.1 home stays off)

dualsense_trigger_strength.label: Adaptive Trigger Strength
dualsense_trigger_strength.help: 0% turns the resistance off. Applies the next time the game starts.
dualsense_trigger_strength.why: the R2 resistance force as a percentage of the D-105 force (100% = force 60); the start position, R2's input and gameplay are never scaled

dualsense_speaker.label: DualSense controller speaker
dualsense_speaker.help: Plays the game's own power-up jingle through the DualSense speaker when Rayman gains a power. USB only; the game's normal sound is unchanged. Applies the next time the game starts.
dualsense_speaker.why: an Xbox 360 pad has no speaker that the PC port can address; an optional, quiet controller-speaker cue for a USB DualSense, off by default so existing audio behaviour is unchanged

dualsense_speaker_volume.label: Controller Speaker Volume
dualsense_speaker_volume.help: Volume of the controller speaker effect. 0% is silent. Applies the next time the game starts.
dualsense_speaker_volume.why: gain of the controller-speaker effect only (the main game mix is never scaled)

diagnostics.label: Diagnostics
diagnostics.help: Standard keeps session logs small and only the 10 newest. Choose Detailed when asked for a problem report. Saves are never affected.
diagnostics.why: release diagnostics bounded by default (two rotated log files, repetitive known lines sampled, the 10 newest sessions of an installed home); detailed = the M30 behaviour
